levels.title: Level 0 — Ad hoc
levels.description: Understand the current quality process and make testing visible.

items.title: Record the current testing baseline
items.description: List existing test types, tools, ownership, and known gaps.

items.title: Identify critical user journeys
items.description: Agree on the user flows that must not break.

levels.title: Level 1 — Repeatable
levels.description: Make essential checks repeatable and easy for the team to run.

items.title: Create a reliable smoke suite
items.description: Cover the highest-priority happy paths with clear results.

levels.title: Level 2 — Managed
levels.description: Add ownership, test data discipline, and predictable defect triage.

items.title: Standardize test data and environments
items.description: Use isolated, documented test data and define cleanup expectations.

levels.title: Level 3 — Defined
levels.description: Document quality standards and make testing part of normal delivery.

items.title: Define test and review standards
items.description: Document naming, review, coverage, and failure-triage conventions.

levels.title: Level 4 — Measured
levels.description: Use stable, actionable measures to find quality bottlenecks.

items.title: Track actionable quality metrics
items.description: Review failure rate, escaped defects, flaky tests, and feedback time.

levels.title: Level 5 — Optimized
levels.description: Reduce waste and improve test speed and reliability using evidence.

items.title: Reduce flaky and redundant checks
items.description: Prioritize recurring failures and remove duplicated low-value coverage.

levels.title: Level 6 — Continuous
levels.description: Automate fast feedback and quality signals across the delivery lifecycle.

items.title: Automate quality gates in CI
items.description: Run the right checks at pull request and release stages.

levels.title: Level 7 — Predictive
levels.description: Use trends and risk signals to focus verification where change is most likely to cause harm.

items.title: Introduce risk-based test selection
items.description: Prioritize checks using change impact and past defect evidence.

levels.title: Level 8 — Adaptive
levels.description: Continuously evolve quality practices from production learning and measured outcomes.

items.title: Close the production feedback loop
items.description: Feed incidents and user-impact findings into priorities and regression coverage.
